component.name: Pereplyot
component.summary: Standalone PDF and EPUB reader with annotations

description.p: Pereplyot (переплёт — Russian for "binding") is a standalone PDF and EPUB reader: highlight, underline, strike, and leave freestanding notes, with full-text search, continuous scroll, and resumed reading position. No library, no vault — just open a file.

ul.li: Open a PDF or EPUB by file picker, drag-and-drop, or "Open With".
Highlights, underlines, strikes, and notes, with export to Markdown.
In-document search, continuous scroll, and facing-pages view for PDFs.
Reading position and annotations remembered per document, no library required.
A recent-files list to jump back into what you were reading.
